scope: Low-level DXF group-5 identity emission for POINTCLOUDDEFINITION, POINTCLOUDDEFINITIONEX, POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOR, and POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOREX.

behavior: Each variant remaps and reserves a nonzero source identity, or allocates an identity when the source handle is zero.
The source object identity is bound only after staged output succeeds.
A fixed output identity is refused before publishing record bytes.
DxfWriterRecordScope and RecordStateScope restore staged bytes and source identity-map changes on late XDATA failure; corrected retry is verified with a fresh writer.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory AC1032 records. No DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
cases: source group-5 remap, unique OBJECTS inventory identity, and source-object binding
typed callback readback for identity, kind, and modeled definition fields
allocated group-5 identity for a source-less definition
fixed-handle remap refusal with destination preservation
late invalid-XDATA rollback of bytes, inventory, and source identity
corrected fresh-writer retry and typed readback

limitations: Generated identity transport only; it does not establish physical producer prevalence or source-to-output association for a complete point-cloud graph.
Definition/reactor target ownership, external point-cloud asset availability, native display behavior, and 3D consumer qualification remain open.
next: Bind PointCloud/PointCloudEx definition and reactor references to the exact emitted typed definition records and source owner graph before adapter admission.
